en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Hafs Al Kunasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The child, when it is born, perform Aqeeqa for him, and shave off his head, give in charity by the weight of the hair, and gift to the mid-wife, the leg (of the sacrificed animal) along with the leaf (silver or gold), and invite a number from the Muslims, so they should be earring and supplicating for the boy, and name him on the seventh day’.
en.sarwar: 12. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Hafs al-Kunasiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘When ‘Aqiqah is offered for a child, his head is shaved, equal to the weight of his hair charity is given, one leg and hip is given to al-Qabilah (the special nurse, doctor), Muslims should be invited and when they are served they should pray for the boy. A name can be given to the child on the seventh day of his birth.’”
